standard_prerequisites.name: Localization of a K-flat complex of modules is K-flat over the localized ring
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives K-flatness of the stalk complexes.

standard_prerequisites.name: A complex of sheaves is K-flat iff all its stalk complexes are K-flat

core_obligations: Stalks: by the More on Algebra base-change lemma, K^bullet tensor_A A_p is a K-flat complex of A_p-modules for every prime p (proof lines 551-553).

Conclusion: by the cohomology stalkwise criterion for K-flatness, together with the description of the stalks of the associated sheaf by the schemes lemma, the complex of O_X-modules is K-flat (proof lines 554-558).
proof_roadmap: Prove K-flatness at every stalk (proof lines 551-553).
Apply the stalkwise K-flatness criterion (proof lines 554-558).
